## Trump Approval Rating at 40% Among Likely Voters

40% of likely voters approve of the job President Trump is doing in office, and 59% disapprove. Likely voters are more than twice as likely to strongly disapprove (53%) of President Trump’s job performance than to strongly approve (24%). The president’s approval rating notches down to 38% among registered voters nationally. Among this group, 61% disapprove. [...] President Trump’s favorable rating is also upside down. 37% of likely voters have a favorable opinion of the president, and 58%, including 14% of Republicans, have an unfavorable impression of him.

In this survey, just 38% of registered voters approved of the job President Trump is doing, with 61% disapproving (-23). Likely voters gave him a 40% to 59% rating (-19), still not very good, but even a slight margin can make a difference in how significant the gains either party might make in the election are.

That said, an equal share — 53% — of registered and likely voters said they "strongly disapprove" of the job Trump is doing, tied with last month as the highest ever in the poll.
